body:
This Mod is for internal usage in our minecraft channel: BAH CRAFT

This mod contains utility items, like a Insta Kill Thor Hammer, another hammers to fly, break blocks and the Thor Hammer balanced.

Also, the mod contains a Boss that uses this Hammer and it also has a wind that make players and mobs fly to the sky!

We want the mod to be easily updated without the need of upload manually the Jar for each participant from the channel.

That's all developed!
